Wayspun

React Native · Expo · TypeScript · Express

A travel guide and trip planner for U.S. states.

面向美国各州的旅行指南和行程规划 App。

Wayspun lets you browse a state's cities and national parks, check the forecast for each place, and plan a trip with several stops on a map.

Wayspun 让你按州浏览城市和国家公园，查看每个地点的天气预报，并在地图上规划有多个站点的行程。

I have built most of the current app: the Explore and place screens, the 7-day forecast from Open-Meteo, the trip detail screen with a route map, numbered stops and per-stop weather, the navigation drawer, and a small Express API for AI-assisted guide import. The screen designs come from our team's Figma file.

目前这版 App 大部分是我做的：探索页和地点页、来自 Open-Meteo 的 7 天预报、带路线地图、编号站点和每站天气的行程详情页、侧边抽屉，以及一个用于 AI 导入攻略的小型 Express 接口。界面设计来自我们团队的 Figma 文件。

Next Bring the cloud look from my weather app into Wayspun, using the seasonal color palettes already drafted in the theme files.

下一步 把我天气 App 里的云朵风格带进 Wayspun，使用主题文件里已经写好的四季配色。

Factorial

Java · libGDX

A factory simulation game.

工厂模拟游戏。

Inspired by Factorio: mines and factories produce goods to meet demand, and you connect them with roads placed on a grid. It runs as a GUI game, as a command-line simulation, or as a multiplayer client and server.

灵感来自 Factorio：矿场和工厂生产物品来满足需求，你在网格上铺路把它们连起来。可以作为图形界面游戏、命令行模拟，或多人联机的客户端和服务器运行。

I wrote the road routing and parts of the interface: the grid renderer, the main menu, and the input handling for placing buildings and roads. The diagram shows the routing rule on a small grid.

我写了道路寻路，以及界面的一部分：网格渲染、主菜单，以及放置建筑和道路的输入处理。右边的图在小网格上演示这条寻路规则。

Building建筑 Existing road, cost 1现有道路，代价 1 Empty tile, cost 2空地，代价 2 Chosen path选中的路径

Routing rule on a small grid, simplified.

小网格上的寻路规则，已简化。

More work更多项目

Weather forecast app天气预报 App

React Native · Expo · TypeScript

A forecast app that opens on the weather where you are. It reads your location, looks up the zip code with Geoapify, and loads the forecast from WeatherAPI.com. It has a landscape layout, a background photo for each favorite with a text-color switch for readability, and light and dark palettes.

打开就是你当前位置天气的预报 App。读取定位，用 Geoapify 查出邮编，再从 WeatherAPI.com 加载预报。有横屏布局、每个收藏地点可设置背景照片并可反转文字颜色，以及浅色和深色两套配色。

OCP APAC 3D experience

HTML · JavaScript · Three.js

At Heron Power, I built an interactive browser 3D model of a battery backup unit and a solid-state transformer, with an electrical simulation driven by data-center load.

在 Heron Power 实习时，我做了一个可交互的浏览器 3D 模型，展示电池备份单元和固态变压器，并带有由数据中心负载驱动的电气仿真。

SSD + S3 filesystem

Go · FUSE · AWS SDK · MinIO

Asynchronous write-back for dirty blocks in an SSD cache backed by S3-compatible storage, coordinated with cache eviction.

SSD 缓存的异步回写：对接 S3 兼容存储，处理脏块，并与缓存淘汰协调。

Battleship

Java · Gradle

A terminal game against a computer player, with ship shapes of different sizes, placement rules, and a sonar action. Covered by unit tests.

终端里和电脑对战的游戏，有不同形状的船、摆放规则和声纳功能，带单元测试。
